name: animated-gradient-text
title: Animated Gradient Text
description: An animated gradient background which transitions between colors for text.
usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AnimatedGradientText } from '@/components/ui/animated-gradient-text'
</script>

<template>
  <AnimatedGradientText class="text-4xl font-semibold">Introducing Vue Magic UI</AnimatedGradientText>
</template>

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed multiplier. The gradient is `speed × 300%` wide, so it travels further each loop.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The text to paint with the gradient.
